note: Both sets are heavily redundant, restating the same four or five equations many times, but Set A's restatements are mostly faithful to Eqs. (7-6) through (7-10), keeping the Region 3 and negligible-rotor-speed-variation conditions and the full-span blade-pitch definition. Set B introduces more defects: a garbled entity ('Gen 2 Gear'), several quotes with mangled LaTeX ('rac{...}'), truncated quotes ('on 3 is inversely proportional...'), quotes altered with bracketed insertions ('the [torque]'), a PID variant that drops the integral sign, and a vague 'negligible variation' claim. Set A's main errors are one PID rendering that misbinds the gains as K_{P N_Gear} etc. and one that drops the dot on the derivative term; Set B repeats the dot-dropping error and adds roughly half a dozen further misread or unsupported items.
